title: Document Statistics & CJK-Aware Word Count
acceptanceCriteria: Exact parity with packages/muya/src/utils/index.ts wordCount on ASCII, CJK (\u4E00-\u9FA5), multi-blank-line paragraphs, and empty input.
UTF-16 code-unit parity for character and all counts.
Zero panics on malformed or large documents.
Status bar in marktext-gpui renders live word/character/paragraph counts from marktext-core.
